text:
jen: Kicking off a shadow rollout for the quantized model now — shadow=20% -> production/llama-3-q4v2-shadow (v2026-quant2). Please monitor SLO dashboards and watch for regressions.

deploy-bot: Started shadow rollout: id=r-2026q2, routing_rule/793, target=20% traffic, initiated_by=jen.

sam: watching gen-api p95 and 5xx, will call out any blips.

maya: eyeballing embed-service metrics — p95 spiked from ~120ms to ~320ms in the last minute for eu-west.

sam: confirmed on traces. kv_miss_rate jumped to 0.18, a few 503s in logs: `GET /v1/embeddings 503`.

aaron: canary dashboard shows error budget burn ~0.6% in 1m window — our deploy window cutoff is 0.5%.

ops-bot: Alert: gen-api.p95 (eu-west) crossed threshold (0.32s) — firing to oncall.

jen: ok let's hold traffic. Pause shadow rollout and set routing_rule/793 -> 0% until we triage.

deploy-bot: Pausing rollout: routing_rule/793 traffic set to 0% by jen. Audit record created: action=pause, reason="p95 spike on embed-service".

maya: I'll open a brief incident doc with initial findings and attach flamegraphs. Starting link: https://wiki.internal/incident/INC-2026-84

sam: suggestion — try a warm-replay to exercise kv cache before another shadow run: `tooling/replay --warm-cache --model llama-3-q4v2-shadow --samples 500`.

aaron: +1. Also recommend a short gated canary (5% for 10m) after warm-replay and runbook smoke checks (latency p95, kv_miss_rate, 5xx).

jen: agreed. Plan: warm-replay now, collect traces, then schedule a 5% canary tomorrow morning during off-peak. If metrics stable for 20m, resume incremental shadow. Otherwise rollback to v2026-stable for generation routes.

sam: noted. tagging observability: `tags:deploy=shadow-2026q2,owner=jen,triage=embed-p95`.

maya: attaching quick log excerpt to the incident doc and flagging any correlation with kv shard rebalances.

jen: thanks — glad we caught it early. Will update release notes with pause + triage summary. :thumbsup:
